name: opcua-negotiated-secure-channel-message-3270
instr:
gopcua cannot plan secure-channel messages or enforce negotiated outbound limits before transmission. Add deterministic, security-aware planning that matches the framing emitted for requests and responses.

`MessageLimitsOption` from `github.com/gopcua/opcua` must combine local limits with HEL/ACK peer limits, choosing the smaller nonzero bound and preserving zero-as-unlimited negotiation. Expose `MessageLimits`, `WireSizer`, `Header.WireSize`, `MessageHeader.WireSize`, `SymmetricSecurityHeader.WireSize`, `SequenceHeader.WireSize`, `PlanErrorKind`, `PlanError`, `ChunkPlan`, `MessagePlan`, and `SecureChannel.PlanRequest` through `github.com/gopcua/opcua/uasc`. Headers must report exact encoded contributions. Invalid framing and arithmetic overflow must return the corresponding typed planning failure, not a usable size.

Plans must include asymmetric or symmetric framing and policy-dependent signatures, padding, encryption, and block expansion before enforcing message, chunk-count, and chunk-size limits. OPN rejects unsupported multi-chunk bodies. MSG emits ordered intermediate chunks and exactly one final chunk. CLO keeps its message type in every chunk. An exact-capacity body needs no extra chunk.

Every successful `MessagePlan` exposes `BodySize` and `Chunks`. Encoding must match each `ChunkPlan` in count, `ChunkType`, `BodySize`, and `WireSize`, preserving body order. Client-request and server-response limit failures occur before output. Responses preserve incoming correlat
